duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanagh-fir lanā dhunūbanā wa isrāfanā fī amrinā wa thabbit aqdāmanā wanṣurnā ʿalal-qawmil-kāfirīn.
duas.translation: Our Lord! Forgive us our sins and anything We may have done that transgressed our duty: Establish our feet firmly, and help us against those that resist Faith

duas.arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Lā yukallifullāhu nafsan illā wusʿahā, lahā mā kasabat wa ʿalayhā maktasabat. Rabbanā lā tu’ākhidhnā in nasīnā aw akhṭa’nā. Rabbanā wa lā taḥmil ʿalaynā iṣran kamā ḥamaltahū ʿalal-ladhīna min qablinā. Rabbanā wa lā tuḥammilnā mā lā ṭāqata lanā bih, waʿfu ʿannā waghfir lanā warḥamnā. Anta Mawlānā fanṣurnā ʿalal-qawmil-kāfirīn.
duas.translation: On no soul doth Allah Place a burden greater than it can bear. It gets every good that it earns, and it suffers every ill that it earns. (Pray) 'Our Lord! Condemn us not if we forget or fall into error... Thou art our Protector: Help us against those who stand against faith.'

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā afrigh ʿalaynā ṣabranw-wa thabbit aqdāmanā wanṣurnā ʿalal-qawmil-kāfirīn.
duas.translation: Our Lord! Pour out constancy on us and make our steps firm: Help us against those that reject faith.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَاجْعَل لِّي مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَانًا نَّصِيرًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbi adkhilnī mudkhala ṣidqinw-wa akhrijnī mukhraja ṣidqinw-wa ajʿal lī milladunka sulṭānan naṣīrā.
duas.translation: O my Lord! Let my entry be by the Gate of Truth and Honour... grant me from Thy Presence an authority to aid (me).

duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi innī limā anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqīr.
duas.translation: O my Lord! truly am I in (desperate) need of any good that Thou dost send me!

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ashraḥ lī ṣadrī, wa yassir lī amrī, waḥlul ʿuqdatan mil-lisānī, yafqahū qawlī.
duas.translation: O my Lord! expand me my breast, ease my task for me, and remove the impediment from my speech, so they may understand what I say.

duas.arabic: رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِي مُنزَلًا مُّبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنزِلِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi anzilnī munzalan mubārakanw-wa Anta Khayrul-Munzilīn.
duas.translation: O my Lord! enable me to disembark with Thy blessing, for Thou art the Best to enable (us) to disembark.

duas.arabic: أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.translation: Truly distress has seized me, but Thou art the Most Merciful of those that are merciful.
